description: This file implements a provider-agnostic reply routing mechanism, including functions to route replies to channels, handle reply payloads, and determine routable channels. It manages reply delivery logic, external dependencies, and configuration handling within a messaging system.

methods.name: loadDeliverRuntime
methods.description: Lazily loads the deliver-runtime module and caches the promise.

methods.name: routeReply
methods.description: Routes a reply payload to a specified channel, handling payload normalization, transport, and delivery, with error handling and support for cancellation.

methods.name: isRoutableChannel
methods.description: Determines if a given channel type is routable via the routeReply function, excluding internal message channels.
